header: Transforming indexes in Amazon OpenSearch Service
content:
Whereas index rollup jobs let you reduce data granularity by rolling up old data into condensed
indexes, transform jobs let you create a diﬀerent, summarized view of your data centered around
certain ﬁelds, so you can visualize or analyze the data in diﬀerent ways.
Index transforms have an OpenSearch Dashboards user interface and a REST API. The feature
requires OpenSearch 1.0 or later.
Note
This documentation provides a brief overview of index transforms to help you get started
using it on an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain. For comprehensive documentation and
a REST API reference, see Index transforms in the open source OpenSearch documentation.
